summary: Single-key indexed join probes can treat the right probe key as guaranteed by the index lookup when there is no residual predicate or right-side selection.
A regression test can prove probe-key decode avoidance by corrupting only the right-side probe key column while projecting another right-side column.
Production medium repeat passed with 3/3 matrices, 0 case errors, 0 unstable suites, and 1 unstable case.
